question_text: Describe how to calculate a person’s completed years of age from birth year/month/day and today’s year/month/day, assuming a valid ordinary date.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Subtract birth year from current year, then subtract one more if the current month/day is before the birthday this year.

marking_points.criterion: Adjusts by one before this year’s birthday.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.
